_produced_by: Claude Code acting as the Commercial Intelligence and Buyer Intelligence runtime, 2026-08-11. Public web only, free tier. No paid enrichment, no contact.

findings.claim: The trading name Premier FM is operated by Otthonbiztonsagban.hu Kft., tax number 26381183-2-07, registered at 8000 Szekesfehervar, Horvat Istvan lakotelep 3. fszt.

The homepage publishes counter labels for years of experience, operated area, assignments, satisfied clients and subcontractors, and every one appears without a numeric value. No employee count and no client count is published anywhere on the site.
Two operating staff are published with direct phone numbers and direct email addresses: a Facility manager and an Ertekesitesi vezeto.
The single published address is in Szekesfehervar, not Budapest. No second location is published.

commercial_value_band.why_null: No price, no contract value, no client count and no headcount is published. There is no published quantity to multiply. A band here would be a fabrication with a number attached.

commercial_intelligence.procurement_basis: Two named staff with direct addresses and no published procurement policy or tender history. A decision here is very likely one or two people.
commercial_intelligence.engagement_size_basis: A Hungarian Kft with two published operating staff and a single location is the size BridgeWorks has actually delivered for. Oliviks was smaller; CEEFM was comparable.
unresolved_questions: Headcount and turnover band from the Hungarian company register, which was not queried in this pass.
Whether the missing KPI counter values are a rendering fault or were never populated. That changes whether the observed gap is a five-minute fix or a proof problem.

problem_owner.why: The observed problem is credibility proof immediately before the quote route. The sales director owns the quote route.

budget_owner.why: No signing authority is published. In a Kft this size it is plausibly the managing director, but plausible is not evidence.

decision_maker.why: No managing director or owner is named anywhere on the site.
